## Sprint objectives

What this sprint should achieve, and why it matters to the user story.

## Steps

- [ ] Step 1
- [ ] Step 2

## Tests to add

Which tests will be written after the code (include tests for errors, not
only the normal case).

## Documentation to update

Which pages or docstrings change.

## Reading and resources

Links to the documentation, articles or examples used for this sprint.

## Branch

Name the branch after this issue number, for example `feature/12-short-name`.

## Retrospective

Fill this in when the sprint is finished: what went well, what did not, what
to change next time. Leave this issue open so it stays visible.
